title: AMD skill eval machine requirements
description: Optional file at skills/<name>/evals/machine.yml, present ONLY for skills whose behavior cases cannot run on the default runners. Absent means the default Strix Halo runners on Linux and Windows, which is the common case. This exists so the hardware requirement is declared next to the skill by the person who knows about the hardware, instead of in a hardcoded list inside a CI workflow.

runner.description: GitHub Actions runs-on labels for the behavior job. A list is the usual form for self-hosted runners.

os.description: Which platforms to exercise. Defaults to both. Set to ["Linux"] for a skill that shells out to Linux-only tooling, which replaces the pytest.mark.skipif guards this format retired.

gate.description: Pull-request label that must be present before this skill's behavior job runs. For scarce or expensive hardware (e.g. enable_mi_ci for the shared MI300X runner). Without the label CI warns rather than failing, so the PR is not blocked by a test it deliberately skipped.

environment.description: GitHub Actions environment whose secrets the behavior job may read. Scopes a key to one job instead of the whole repo.

reason.description: Why this skill needs special hardware, for the human reading the PR.
